question: persister
prompt:
Research question: "What measurements or analyses would best reveal why a small fraction of genetically identical cancer cells survive targeted drug treatment?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

Work in two steps. First, in the candidates field, brainstorm 20 candidate ideas, one line each, covering as wide a range as you can. Then select the 5 candidates that best combine being non-obvious with being feasible and informative, and develop those as your ideas.

ideas.title: Barcoded sister-cell lineage tracing with transcriptome readout
ideas.description: Label cells with expressed lineage barcodes, split each clone into two halves, and profile one by scRNA-seq before treatment while treating the other. Surviving barcodes reveal the pre-treatment transcriptional state that predicted survival, and show whether persistence is pre-existing or induced.

ideas.title: Live-cell imaging with retrospective fate mapping
ideas.description: Time-lapse image cells carrying reporters (pathway activity, cell cycle, mitochondrial state) for days before drug addition, then track each cell and its descendants through treatment. Correlate pre-drug dynamics and heritability across sister cells with survival to find predictive features.

ideas.title: Fluctuation test to separate switching from mutation
ideas.description: Perform Luria-Delbruck style assays with many parallel small clonal populations, plus drug-holiday re-challenge, and fit models to estimate phenotypic switching rates and memory duration. Combined with sequencing of survivors, this distinguishes genetic, epigenetic and stochastic origins.

ideas.title: Sorting on pre-treatment physiology, then drug challenge
ideas.description: Use FACS to isolate untreated cells by mitochondrial membrane potential, drug uptake or efflux (fluorescent analogs), size or slow-cycling dye retention, and measure survival of each fraction. This directly tests which physiological axes causally enrich persisters.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome with epigenetic perturbation
ideas.description: Profile chromatin accessibility and expression jointly (scATAC plus RNA) in pre-persister and persister cells, and identify candidate regulators. Validate by CRISPRi/a or chromatin inhibitors targeting those regulators to see whether persister frequency shifts.

candidates: Lineage barcoding (e.g., ClonTracer/Perturb-seq style) to test whether persisters are pre-existing or drug-induced
Single-cell RNA-seq before and after drug with barcode-matched sister cells

Sister-cell pair survival correlation (heritability of persistence over generations)
